name: cue
description: Open-source macOS invisible AI overlay — three separate inputs (screen, mic, system audio) into an LLM. A Cluely-style copilot for meetings and coding problems.
author: cue

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: cue transcribes your microphone so it can help you in conversations.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: cue does not use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: cue captures system audio to transcribe the other participant in a call.
